newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil's aromatics facility completed.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil's aromatics facility completed.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it had completed construction of a three billion yen facility which produces aromatics needed to help meet growing Asian demand for polyester.

The toluene disproportionation facility developed by U.S. oil firm Mobil Corp consumes 200,000 tonnes of toluene per year, Mitsubishi Oil said in a statement. The facility produces 90,000 tonnes each of xylene and benzene a year, it said.
A high proportion, about 80 percent, of the xylene produced from the facility is paraxylene, which will then be used in a paraxylene production unit to enhance output, it said.
Paraxylene is used to make polyester.

When work to expand Mitsubishi Oil's existing paraxylene output unit ends in June, the Mizushima refinery in western Japan will have a total production capacity of 400,000 tonnes per year, up 70,000 tonnes from the current capacity, the statement said.

Mitsubishi Oil, which also has a 150,000 tonne-per-year paraxylene production unit in Oita prefecture, southern Japan, will become Japan's top paraxylene maker, overtaking Idemitsu Petrochemical Co Ltd, it said.
